title: sea: mount vfsArchive at layer 0 and in workers

target.summary: Worker threads unconditionally require `internal/vfs/sea` during startup even when not running in a single-executable application with a VFS archive. This causes every worker thread to eagerly load `internal/vfs/sea` and `internalBinding('sea')`, violating bootstrap isolation and breaking `parallel/test-bootstrap-modules`.
notes: faulty statement: unconditionally requires internal/vfs/sea during worker startup
implementation of initSeaVfsInWorker called at worker startup
